programme.title: 僵尸先生粤
programme.desc: 任老爷之父任老太爷下葬二十年后,任老爷依照当时下葬时的风水师建议起棺迁葬,茅山师父九叔受任老爷所托处理事宜,惟起棺后,大家发现任老太爷下葬二十年后,毫无腐化迹象,九叔建议火化不果,于是把棺木寄放在义庄nn棺木迁到义庄后,因任老太爷死时仍有一道气积在喉咙,于是尸变变成僵尸,杀害了任老爷命案发生不久,九叔曾一度被大队长阿威怀疑是凶手,后因任老爷亦尸变变作僵尸,差点送命的阿威也被九叔及徒弟秋生

programme.title: 百份百感觉II粤普
programme.desc: Jerry和许乐为相识多年的中学同学,情同手足,毕业后更同居一室,过著无忧无虑的单身生活Jerry接受一个有关年青人恋爱心态的访问,遇上二十一岁的论文老师海素

programme.title: 摆渡人粤普
programme.desc: 每座城市都有属于自己的传奇,这座城市的传奇就是摆渡人据说,摆渡人能消除世间痛苦酒吧老板陈末和拍挡管春,平时看起来吊儿郎当,但其实是金牌摆渡人,空手接白刃,人肉千斤顶,只要你预约,就无所不能

programme.title: 英雄本色II粤
programme.desc: 香港警方怀疑宋子豪(狄龙 饰)的恩师龙四(石天 饰)利用船厂做掩护,暗中操纵伪钞集团,遂派宋子杰(张国荣 饰)去做卧底接近龙四的女儿龙晓晖(简慧真 饰)宋子豪为了弟弟的安全,不得不假释出狱,协助警方调查nn其实龙四早已欲退出江湖,实际上真正暗中操纵伪钞集团为自己手下高英培(关山 饰)陷害,使龙四不得不逃亡到美国纽约投靠前手下在龙四逃亡到纽约期间,龙四女儿被高英培枪杀,高英培更聘杀手追杀

programme.title: 大内密探零零发粤
programme.desc: 零零恭,零零喜,零零发,零零财四个人,是负责保卫明朝皇帝安全的「保龙一族」阿恭,阿喜,阿财三人都是武艺高强的特工;阿发是唯一不懂武功的,只会搞些小发明,始终不被皇上重用,大多伪装成妇科医师给人看病,随时等皇帝的诏命nn当时的中国北方,有女真族建立的金国,金国的「无相王」,是一位拥有无上武艺的高手,他练就「无相神功」,脸部没有五官,可以「隔山打牛」,还可以幻化成他人状貌,以欺骗他人,并一心

programme.title: 久别重逢粤普
programme.desc: 那年盛夏,少女夏文萱(许恩怡 饰)与少年苏升华(陈卓贤 饰),因一张唱片相遇,但对这段青涩的爱情,不知能走多远⋯⋯多年后,已成为音乐人的苏升华(郑伊健 饰),在人生低谷时,意外重逢夏文萱(蔡思韵 饰)被病困的夏文萱心痛眼前苏升华变化如此,决定为他送上最后礼物,希望这段旅程能让他找到人生改变⋯⋯

programme.title: 烈火青春粤
programme.desc: 汤镇业出生于一个偏门世家,认识了留学日本归来的夏文汐他们的朋友张国荣和叶童亦是臭味相投的一对,张是富家子弟,叶则从事模特儿工作有一次,叶因工作关系,认识了一位日本时装界的女活跃份子,她有意提携他们,大家不虞有诈,谁料因此而卷入国际性的赤军行动之中

programme.title: 窃听风云粤普
programme.desc: 香港刑事情报科和商业罪案调查科合作查缉「风华国际」上市公司中的洗钱,诈骗,非法操控股价等商业罪案,调查科主管黄福荣下令要先从三大股东徐伟,费国雄和罗耀明身上调查窃听三人组阿俊,老杨与小祥共同潜入风华国际办公室安装多数高端窃听器和监视器,在公司对面大楼的据点开始轮班形式的监视窃听工作,记录下三大股东的所有对话内容,会谈对象,以及金钱交易而老杨和小祥于一天夜里监视到罗耀明陪他的秘书兼女友林绮

programme.title: 逆鳞普
programme.desc: 尊非(沈腾 饰)带著一帮兄弟投靠了黑白两道通吃的富商黄朝晋(高捷 饰)并成为他的左膀右臂,在素有「黄金之城」的澳门混得风生水起面对帮派厮杀,黑帮权力暗斗,人性博弈,尊非在情与义的纠缠中以命搏命,陷入了一场为他而设的生死赌局

programme.title: 财叔之横扫千军粤普
programme.desc: 一九三零年代,中国正值多事之秋,溥仪成立伪满洲政府,与日本人秘研化学武器国军蒙中尉被派往满洲国破坏溥仪计划途中,他遇上自动请缨的财叔,大鼻林等人蒙认为财叔年事已高,不能胜任,遂每次调动都把众人当后勤

programme.title: 意外的恋爱时光普
programme.desc: 单身女白领王乐晴(郭采洁饰)对生活期望很高,希望早日与男友邵东(高圣远饰)走上结婚的红毯但卲东是个工作狂,常常因工作忽视了自己的存在,乐晴不得已主动向男友求婚,并请周同(房祖名饰)拍摄她的求爱过程

programme.title: 见怪
programme.desc: 失明的游己任在离岛的工厂工作。一天,因飓风的破坏,工厂与外界隔绝。此时突然有一只怪物来袭,任何看到怪物的人都会化成黑影。因游己任看不见怪物,他能成功协助伙伴安全离开,更奋战反击,誓要杀死怪物!

programme.title: Tear Us Apart
programme.desc: 幼女离奇失踪后,悲痛的Drew与Helen在治疗师安排下,前往偏远林中小屋接受深度咨商。随著孤立与压抑逐渐侵蚀理智,疗愈之旅化为噩梦。Helen饱受诡异幻象与异象困扰,逐渐分不清现实与幻觉,心智濒临崩

programme.title: 密室逃生
programme.desc: 三位网红相约前往荒岛直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老妇诱骗至偏远孤岛。原来这是一场精心策划的陷阱,她们竟成了老妇为伤残孙儿物色新娘的猎物。面对日益疯狂的囚禁与威胁,她们必须争分夺秒逃离这座噩梦孤岛。

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 电影由三个恐怖短故事组成:一个男人收到死神通报后,设法避过死亡;男人因心爱的妻子去世后伤心欲绝,他的妻子变成鬼魂与他通灵;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚会上为照顾年迈母亲的问题而争吵,最后竟变成一宗可怕的谋杀案。

programme.title: The Elite of Devils
programme.desc: 五名大学生受委派前往一座神秘庄园进行专题研究,并结识了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,却发现她隐藏著致命秘密。随著她的恶魔力量逐渐觉醒,原本的学术之旅瞬间化为生死逃亡,他们必须对抗统治阶层延续数百年的诅咒。

programme.title: 封门村惊魂
programme.desc: 民国年间,江南村落接连发生离奇命案,逐渐沦为远近闻名的鬼村「封门村」。记者李穆与员警万枫为追查一宗灭门惨案,深入阴森村庄抽丝剥茧,n誓要揭开连环命案背后的真相,破除流传已久的封建迷信。

programme.title: Mulu Nakru (The Masters Face)
programme.desc: 建筑师May与男友Gun搬入新居后,骤闻继母离奇身亡。May收留孤苦的继妹Noon,怎料她入宅后竟行为诡异,频遭恶灵附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象与严重失眠的折磨。随著宅内黑暗秘密逐步揭开,通灵法师终于

programme.desc: 谢毅忠年少时跳童请神,请来的竟是大伯爷白无常,酿成一场无法挽回的悲剧,自此再也不敢请神。多年后重返故乡,村中诡异怪事接连发生,至亲性命危在旦夕。面对邪灵作祟,他能否再次请神出煞,化解这场生死劫难?

programme.title: 征战火焰山 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探访喀拉喀托之子火山(Anak Krakatoa),当它进入剧烈活跃阶段时这座火山被称为「火之子」,它是喀拉喀托火山的后代,而喀拉喀托火山以现代史上最大规模的喷发而闻名它的后代是否会重演同样的模式?

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展开由月球力量引导的史诗般的旅程看看无形的信号如何指引鲸鱼和海龟沿著海洋迁徙路线,与夜鹰鸟一起穿越大陆,并观察粪甲虫及其他依靠月光导航的昆虫

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与小袋鼠一起躲避长满鳞片与覆满羽毛的危险威胁,观察库拉马那蜥蜴为了争夺配偶而激烈交战,并与刚孵化的鳄鱼幼体一同进食在雨季来临之际,勇闯危险的急流,理解一条在地河流在文化层面与生物层面上的重要意义

programme.title: 大猫九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与一只小小的幼狮一起在森林中穿行,观看年轻的成年狮如何宣示自己的领土,并见证年老猎人的不可避免的流亡发现本能和潜行如何帮助老虎在它孤独的世界中生存,在这里每一个决定都充满风险

programme.title: 超兽 #5
programme.desc: 向大自然中最古老、最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低头致敬看虎鲨如何利用海龟筑巢时的混乱展开猎食,和肩章鲨一起在缺氧环境中生存,并和幽灵鲨一起承受深海惊人的高压

programme.title: 超兽 #6
programme.desc: 跟著各式各样的鲨鱼在海洋中巡游,看看为什么这些掠食性鱼类能够称霸海底世界和礁鲨一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宫之中,和须鲨一起潜伏等待最完美的攻击时机,并和大白鲨一起展开史诗般的大迁徙

programme.title: 扎根 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壮丽的骆驼刺树这棵相思树已经在此屹立了两个世纪在这片干旱的地貌中,这棵骆驼刺树是大大小小生物的避难所善于交际的织布鸟、绿豆象甲虫和各种哺乳类动物在喀拉哈里活用这棵标志性的树

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #5
programme.desc: 尚比亚的卢安瓜谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正让它变得特别的是鸟类这里有超过400种不同的物种;每个都完美地适应利用所提供的每个机会

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展开由月球力量引导的史诗般的旅程看看无形的信号如何指引鲸鱼和海龟沿著海洋迁徙路线,与夜鹰鸟一起穿越大陆,并观察粪甲虫及其他依靠月光导航的昆虫

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与小袋鼠一起躲避长满鳞片与覆满羽毛的危险威胁,观察库拉马那蜥蜴为了争夺配偶而激烈交战,并与刚孵化的鳄鱼幼体一同进食在雨季来临之际,勇闯危险的急流,理解一条在地河流在文化层面与生物层面上的重要意义

programme.desc: 美食惊喜持续不断!贾斯汀将当地 Living Roots 酒庄的葡萄酒与丰盛的义式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣赏令人叹为观止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),并造访指标性的 Anchor Bar,大口品尝最正宗的水牛城辣鸡翅!纯粹的美味与令人惊艳的美景在此完美交会

programme.desc: 贾斯汀在水牛城大啖经典的烤牛肉午餐,随后乘船启航,前往壮丽的千岛群岛(1000 Islands)和博尔特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在风景如画的水域沿岸一边烹饪、一边探索,最后她在奢华的萨加莫尔度假村(Sagamore Resort)为这难忘的一天画上休止符

programme.title: 纽约美食指南 #6
programme.desc: 盛大的压轴好戏火热登场!贾斯汀在 Toad Hill 枫糖农场搭配新鲜糖浆制作了苹果煎饼,接著大啖萨拉托加(Saratoga)炸鸡,最后在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一顿令人难忘的最终盛宴,为她这场史诗般的纽约冒险带来最完美的加冕!

programme.title: 席琳狄翁:爱无止境

programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general

programme.title: The Natural History of the Chicken
programme.desc: A quirky documentary exploring chickens beyond food, through eccentric stories of headless runners, supernatural tales, and a woman who'd rather bond than eat them

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around

programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber

programme.desc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution

programme.title: Twisted Tales
programme.desc: We delve into the world of flies, exploring ehtir annoying habits, vast numbers, and surprising benefits From spreading diseases like malaria to playing vitalroles in nature, flies are more than just pests Discover their fascinating behaviors, contributions to medical science, and unique adaptations that make them one of the most successful groups of insects

programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 福气教会讲道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康强盛的教会? 改变社区可以转化城市? 作为基督徒,我们又如何尽忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一个「幸福小组」,让教会续步履行三个使命!由台湾高雄福气教会牧者主讲,从《圣经》的话语开始,一起来学习「幸福」智慧!

programme.desc: 喜清早决战四方城，原来是喜听到庆参加义诊团所进行的报复。朋对庆游说失败，续约庆行山，欲以用行动来证明庆根本无力应付云南的恶劣环境。纵使朋有充分的行山装备，仍敌不过精力充沛的庆，朋更不支晕倒被送入院。

programme.title: 说英雄谁是英雄#3粤普PG
programme.desc: 出发前，苏梦枕将红袖刀交给要假扮成他的小石，并教他一个招式，说江湖中人看到就会相信；苏遮幕将扳指交给苏梦枕，叮嘱他要守好这个江湖，并要他去问花无错是否知错，父子俩一起喝下最后一杯酒，梦枕登上楼主之位。

阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 六号向肥妈请教潮爆食谱，肥妈先要他以「厨房神器」做出「早餐6食」，「啡菇伴蛋」、「咖喱饭冬甩」、「迷你pizza」轻易完成！肥妈用元贝、椰菜做出特色大阪烧饼，六号用小聪明设计稳妥方法，再也不怕翻动美食！「羊肉黄姜饭」、「香烤羊架伴鲜羊肚菌」，做法简单得令六号嚷着要与肥妈斗煮。「吸」出心形酥皮、倒入蛋浆，数分钟后，爱心满载的「一口酥皮蛋挞」新鲜出炉。六号喂食时惨「食柠檬」，说了甚么令肥妈笑到肚痛？

programme.title: 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 运输及物流局积极推动本港的海空联运，节目《航向未来》由星级艺员吴伟豪、郭柏妍担纲演出，并饰演初到海运前线的实习生，透过实况情节，介绍当局如何精准高效地协调货船泊进港口后，把船上货物经香港转运出海，继而运往世界各地，同时为国际航运业绿色减碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 「口干燥症」患者因口水分泌不足，可能会影响进食、吞咽、说话，甚或引致口臭、味觉改变等状况，曾接受电疗、常用口呼吸人士都是高危一族。牙医建议针对源头做舒缓及保护，还要关注口腔卫生。高胆固醇是「三高」之一，中医学把它归类为「脂浊」、「痰湿」，并与肾脏及脾胃有关。治疗方面，主要根据病因而用药及针灸，中医师也会介绍相关穴位按压方法，并提醒饮食上的注意事项。「睇𩠌食饭」，陈国宾炮制「青口汁粟米焖鸡」。

programme.title: 拍档厨房粤
programme.desc: 《拍档厨房》每次请来两对由艺员与厨师组成的搭档，参加四个回合的比赛。首集先是「拍档联乘」，评判顾纪筠、黄永帜、方晓岚、颜志恒从味道等三准则，品尝评分。龚嘉欣不乏餐饮业经验，与酒店餐厅大厨李家铤做拍档，献上别开生面的「宝石紫姜皮蛋」。对家「疫境厨神」黎诺懿伙拍擅长非一般法国菜的沈依红，以「葱油蛏子天使面」打头阵。不过，两道头盘均被评略嫌不足！两队分别用马友鱼、马头鱼制作的主菜，又能否协助抢分响头炮？

programme.title: 大帅哥#8粤PG
programme.desc: 落芦早料到狄奇去分地盘会失败收场，只想让他认清自己的兵力多么不济，建议用计挑起细龟、佘南互相残杀。落芦终答应加入狄奇的阵营，首要任务是开军校及招兵，罗义、马炭争做实战总教官，密密苦练枪法。马炭慨叹断指影响表现，沅婉内疚地为他倒模做假手指及指套，马炭忆起儿时片段，不自觉握住沅婉的手，刚好被狄奇看见，怀疑二人有染……狄奇向马炭谈起当日放走沅婉的原因，重申只视她为亲人。招兵海报引起偶像效应，却无人报名。

樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子看见花轮的教科书划了萤光笔很漂亮，便问他借来一用，好让自己有动力温习。小丸子发现永泽种了丝瓜田，细问之下得知对方要制作丝瓜擦，小丸子于是跟他学造丝瓜擦，以送给爷爷作生日礼物。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 又来到「粤剧READY GO」游戏，这回的小朋友分成男、女子队比拼。面对有关头饰、「掌板」、上马动作的问题，虽然两队均答错未能得分，晓莹老师却送上暖心鼓励，提醒大家胜负并非重点，最紧要是从错误中吸收正确的粤剧知识！玲玲姐姐于「Artspiration」示范画薄饼，萤幕前的小朋友跟着画时亦可加入喜欢的馅料。用厕纸筒作上色道具，意外造出渐变效果。其间，玲玲姐姐还温馨细诉童年薄饼生日派对的难忘点滴。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 大雄使用「随心所欲手袋」取回失物，却得意忘形以之表演魔术，手袋被胖虎抢走后引发混乱。多啦A梦为流浪猫多啦次郎寻找主人，最后靠「招财猫食品」让拉面店店主收养牠，更错有错著令店铺生意大增。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#74粤
programme.desc: 龚喜生活习惯「滋整」，嘉冰等人诸多不便，嘉骢终于忍无可忍斥责她，更指她只是外人。龚喜深感委屈，躲在房内不肯见人，朱基替她抱不平，更列举事例指摘众人漠视卫生。嘉骢等人才得知龚喜有严重洁癖，遂向她道歉，双方言归于好。龚喜自此再无顾忌，变本加厉灭菌，众人苦不堪言，遂设法劝她与细菌共存，却适得其反。其后，嘉冰获安多勋启发，想到帮助龚喜克服细菌恐惧的方法；岂料龚喜识破计划，更突生变故，嘉冰身陷险境……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#10粤PG 及 才骏HASHTAG 信证窝轮牛熊新势力粤
programme.desc: 《死亡揭露》录影当日，凤仪否认与安安的意外有关……德龙看了子盈的日记，恍然众女对子盈所做的恶行。云生要将凤仪「流放」外地，下属徐晔为凤仪求情不果。云生资金告急，被卡冕国易先生施压。无双与德龙追查发现安安曾以内幕勒索某人，德龙察觉那人可能是菲雅，遂藉接近菲雅以确认。德龙发现宝儿拥有他当年送赠子盈的项链，隐然意会宝儿和子盈的关系。透过天诚招商会的场合，无双认定绮云、凤仪、菲雅都有杀害子盈的嫌疑……

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特约：健康一分钟粤
programme.desc: 三清洞是结合传统、艺术、美食的文青热点，如风「跟风」开展一日游。首站来到地胆推介的家庭式餐厅，品尝热上的「真正泡菜」、白切五花肉，劲满足！为了制作手工锁匙扣行上半山，却得知项目下架，如风唯有转造行李牌，又频频要导师出手代劳……山脚聚集不少潮流店铺，如风沿路找到韩屋雪糕店，试试甜薯焦糖布甸配软雪糕等限定口味。转往特色咖啡厅，望着地标城墙叹甜品，别具格调。乘巴士游览市内风光，醉人日落、夜景一次过收藏！

programme.title: 武则天#31粤普
programme.desc: 媚娘劝李治竞逐太子以保兄长，世民亦查出李泰操控太子之乱。萧蔷服五行草滑胎，将罪名嫁祸韦妃及媚娘。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志之玩转澳门新搞作粤
骗中传奇#16粤
programme.desc: 黑衣人之主子原来是当今皇上嘉庆，他活捉了忠正，要忠正替他辨事，忠正记挂「天下无双酒」一事，遂求嘉庆帮承康解围。事后承康决定结束酒庄，归隐田园。嘉庆要忠正出售宫中宝物，但不可泄漏其来源。一富豪将所有宝物叫价高至三十倍，更全数买下，嘉庆虽对此富豪来历心感疑惑，但仍重赏忠正等人。一班衙差捉去玉麟等人，忠正立即找嘉庆帮忙。嘉庆早料到是权臣和珅所为，立即率众救人。和珅府内，玉麟等正被要胁供出幕后卖家。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 日前尖沙咀宝勒巷发生夺命车祸，一辆私家车失控冲上行人路，酿成1死3伤惨剧。目击者直指涉事司机疑似醉驾，现场市民亦亲述惊险经过。中六女生「报东张」，哭诉遭六名昔日曾视为好友的同学集体霸凌，不但受尽言语辱骂与滋扰，更被恶意「起底」公开其个人资料。事主称因此承受巨大压力，情绪崩溃。面对连串指控，其中两名涉事女生现身反驳，摄制队安排双方对质……陈豪、陈慧琳现身马场，为活动担任嘉宾。另送上实用长者生活情报。

programme.desc: 肥妈购买何首乌、黑豆、猪尾做出多道补肾、护发菜式。「护发首乌汤」内有甚么药材？黑豆虽然有益，但煮「黑豆莲藕焖猪尾」时切忌下太多，为甚么？将海带汆水及「过冷河」后，肥妈用柠檬汁、豆瓣酱、鱼露等混出完美的凉拌酱。肥妈展示创意及「崭新」刀功，为蒸鲈鱼做出「孔雀开屏」的效果。何首乌与芝麻搅碎，另加马蹄粉、粘米粉用水开稀，蒸约半小时，便有一份护发兼讨人欢喜的小甜点端上餐桌！

programme.desc: 运输及物流局积极推动本港的海空联运，节目《航向未来》由星级艺员吴伟豪、郭柏妍担纲演出，并饰演初到海运前线的实习生，透过实况情节，介绍当局如何精准高效地协调货船泊进港口后，把船上货物经香港转运出海，继而运往世界各地，同时为国际航运业绿色减碳出力。

programme.desc: 詹天文、廖嘉敏一同作客节目，畅谈各自参演青春音乐剧续篇的点滴。天文透露将唱演独脚戏，还会邀请现场观众上台互动；嘉敏又会挑战甚么角色？嘉敏本职是心理学家，提到工余时演戏成为她抒发情绪的方式。这次「跟大厨去揾食」，大王、秀怡随许美德师傅走进逾九十年历史的老字号茶室，透过鸡蓉鹧鸪粥、烧云腿鹌鹑球、脆皮糯米鸡、玉簪炒田鸡腿等怀旧手工菜，细味昔日香港饮食文化。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，三姐示范「臭豆荞头粉丝虾煲」。

programme.title: 拍档厨房粤

programme.desc: 小丸子想吃番薯蛋糕，但妈妈不肯买，她于是想到用举行读书会作借口，让妈妈买蛋糕回来招待朋友。小丸子化身童话故事《不莱梅乐队》的驴子，与花猫、狗和公鸡结伴前往不莱梅温泉乐园组乐队谋生。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 参与「厂长话」游戏时，太「听话」或是一大弱点。某小兵于热身赛照单全收，每个动作指令都跟着做……进入淘汰赛，两队战况非常激烈，哪一方可以留到最后？采摘水果的任务，曲奇队于果园不慎「失手」了两次，薯片队则与障碍物完全「零接触」，只是脚步声有点大！最后一关是要走过「溶化之桥」，大家都勇于挑战运送六个雪糕球！有人失手后再接再厉，却见顶层雪糕球不停摇动，只得暂时停步，待稳定下来后才继续前行……

programme.title: 蓝色管弦乐粤日
programme.desc: 青野在武田老师鼓励下，决定重拾小提琴并报考海幕高中。秋音一边教他温习，一边接受他的指导练琴，二人互相扶持，终于一同考上。入学礼上，他们被海幕高中管弦乐团的震撼演奏深深吸引，新的音乐旅程亦正式展开。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 马百良六宝灵芝呈献:最强生命线粤 及 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 患有阻塞性睡眠窒息症的患者，因睡眠中气道塌陷和缺氧，导致大脑在被「呛醒」的瞬间，会下意识「咬紧牙关」，通过往前顶下巴希望打通呼吸，因此会出现磨牙。据临床统计，患有阻塞性睡眠窒息症的患者，磨牙比率高于一般人，大约每4人就有1人，患者白天出现嗜睡、晨起头痛等并发症。除了第一线治疗使用正压呼吸器，牙科医生可透过矫治器帮助纾缓症状。

黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#75粤
programme.desc: 嘉冰、唐芯与龚喜目睹楚瑠香遭渣男骗财后抛弃，瑠香苦苦纠缠，更险遭动粗，龚喜遂出手制止，唐芯更扬言要替她物色好男人。瑠香恳求三人协助摆设相士所授的桃花阵以催旺姻缘，嘉冰本不以为然，却难敌瑠香百般哀求而心软。原来瑠香为摆桃花阵大费周章，终诱使嘉冰等三人配合她以古怪造型完成仪式，岂料众人后来却揭发一切只是相士的欺诈技俩。嘉冰等人助瑠香追讨赔偿，并替她改造成女神形象，透过交友App成功约会高质素男士……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#11粤PG
programme.desc: 菲雅、绮云、凤仪被加入神秘群组，三人都猜测是无双所为却彼此猜忌。《玫瑰》剧组重组，无双希望由凤仪顶替安安，凤仪为留在云生身边，纵觉有诈仍答允。无双又提出将剧本改成缉凶方向，此时菲雅却表示要辞演。德龙因宝儿持有「海龙之心」项链，怀疑宝儿身分，欲进一步查探时，无双直接告知他答案……云生向家俊提出合作串流平台，家俊欲威胁永康支持……云生面对易先生施压，凤仪的一着成功为云生化解危机。

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特约：健康一分钟粤
programme.desc: 安国站可谓富「历史味道」区域，但只要识玩，也有时尚感。先到排队食店喝一碗浓浓的人参鸡汤，鸡肉、汤分开上，如风略嫌参味不及鸡味浓。百多年历史的韩屋改造成住宿，传统之余亦有现代的智能马桶，如风睡上床就不想离开？另一间法式外表建筑，卖的是低调奢华手袋，爱高调的如风又能否买到心头好？韩国人的咖啡吞吐量不少，如风私心推介既可打卡又好味的民村风咖啡店，代价是花时间觅路。还会走进超人气商店，搜罗即冲咖啡做手信。

programme.title: 武则天#32粤普
programme.desc: 萧蔷滑胎案与刺杀媚娘案令韦妃罪证确凿；李泰助韦妃自尽以保自身。韦家倒台，媚娘继续追查太子案及文娘死因。

骗中传奇#17粤
programme.desc: 和珅暗讽嘉庆出卖国宝，嘉庆唯有委托他建造战船，著他放玉麟等人，但和珅坚持暂将玉麟等人收监。忠正斥嘉庆怕事，独自往救玉麟却被和珅衙差追杀，时宝儿出现，忠正骑上宝儿快马离去。宝儿巳是和珅之宠妾，得悉玉麟被困和珅府，即掉下忠正离去。忠正与嘉庆带同「天下第一牙」牌匾，要和珅看在先帝份上释放玉麟等人，其间和珅及嘉庆均无意中发现「风调雨顺」四个神像之内里干珅。嘉庆委托忠正找出此四神像，忠正施计摆脱和珅之线眼。

programme.title: 高朋满座#233粤
programme.desc: 朋向溢道出身患心脏病，悦却说出婷扭伤的消息。朋担心悦接受不了双重打击，打消向太太坦白念头。另一方面，庆与喜的磨擦进一步白热化，庆更提出要到寺院修行，义更因此在父母面前大发脾气，众人大惊唯有再找朋解决。

programme.title: 说英雄谁是英雄#4粤普PG
programme.desc: 王小石和白愁飞被刑部尚书傅宗书关进牢中，苏梦枕出面救了二人，惟尚书不准二人进入金风细雨楼；二人拒绝加入六分半堂，在京城过著落魄的日子，当二人打算离京之际，被温柔拦下，并在其引见下与苏梦枕结拜为兄弟。

programme.title: 美女厨房粤
programme.desc: 曹永廉、黄浩然再任嘉宾，今次找来黎耀祥一同试食，今集再玩双人赛制，当中两对美女煮得有板有眼，满分美食陆续送上！比较失色的一对，可能与有人「串嘴但有礼貌」有关，主持狠踩她的厨艺，让她突然泪眼盈眶，主持怎样打圆场？指定食材面包蟹有一定份量，黎耀祥竟然只找到两条蟹肉丝？振朗多番要求喂食，视帝黎耀祥亦有「另类」待遇！四位公公聚首，踩人、自嘲自然无极限，不过亦有强差人意菜式令众男一致扫清，背后有何特殊原因？

阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈一连两集煮出十道与虾相关的菜式。两母子走到「虾之百货」，选购生猛基围虾、海中虾及赤米虾入馔。虾仁拍成虾胶，加雪耳、蛋白后搓成丸子，再放上杞子，蒸出满有诗意的「白雪明珠」。买虾通常越大越好，为何「龙井虾仁」的虾仁却越小越好？肥妈教路，轻易煮出「花雕醉虾」、「黄金虾」两道大热菜式，黄金虾加了甚么令食者减轻因蛋黄而生的罪疚感？将赤米虾混入牛油果、番茄之中，「牛油果甜虾莎莎」就此诞生。

programme.title: 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 运输及物流局积极推动本港的海空联运，节目《航向未来》由星级艺员吴伟豪、郭柏妍担纲演出，并饰演初到海运前线的实习生，透过实况情节，介绍当局如何精准高效地协调货船泊进港口后，把船上货物经香港转运出海，继而运往世界各地，同时为国际航运业绿色减碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粤 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特约：健康一分钟粤
programme.desc: 多数更年期女士均会经历潮热，如严重还会影响日常生活，持续潮热亦可增加患上心血管疾病的风险。治疗方面，现时采用的非荷尔蒙药物如何做到改善这症状？留意妇产科医生详细解说。胆管炎有很多种类，成因、治疗方法都不同。外科医生提到，在香港最常见的病因是由胆石引起，胆石又是怎样形成？医生提醒患者不应因胆石体积小而忽略，而均衡饮食与适当运动均有助预防胆石及胆管炎。「睇𩠌食饭」，谭咏仪师傅示范「港味花螺」。

programme.title: 拍档厨房粤
programme.desc: 第四回合，拍档们要透过头盘、主菜、甜品去讲一个故事。黎诺懿、沈依红把冰室美食「法式化」，黎总style的罗宋汤、炒牛河与西多士，令人期待！龚嘉欣、李家铤则思考将饮宴佳肴呈现。嘉欣细心洗刷主打食材鲍鱼，并得评判提醒诀要；加入芭乐、乳酪的杨枝甘露，幻化少女粉红色彩。未评分，两队先自行检讨，有人带漏材料，有人感慨甜品状态不如理想！虽有不足，众评判的评语赞赏不停，最终哪对拍档取胜，率先出线？

programme.title: 大帅哥#10粤PG
programme.desc: 艾妞、天娇送凉茶为军人打气，士气立即飙升！细龟、佘南谈判合作对付狄奇，可惜谈不拢，反被狄奇作弄及恐吓二人不可瓜分禄丰镇。有军人意外偷窥沅婉，马炭反应过于激烈，沅婉从狄奇口中知道马炭失控背后经历。沅婉称可为马炭的指套保用一辈子，马炭情不自禁拥抱她。马炭悄悄送上一瓶狗尾草，沅婉误以为是狄奇所送，甜在心头，马炭脸色一沉，狄奇则似有所悟。军人训练未如理想，军费却所剩无几，狄奇经落芦提醒后要求镇中富商交税。

programme.title: 方德证券独家呈现:交易现场粤 及 方德证券独家呈现:交易先机粤
樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子想知道自己会说什么梦话，于是听从爷爷建议，尝试用录音机录下自己的梦话。小丸子化身日本童话《漏雨老宅》中的小狼女，与一众动物齐心协力调查滨治爷爷所说的最可怕事物是什么东西。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 位于沙头角的谷埔村是一条拥有逾三百年历史的乡村，至今仍保留着深厚的客家文化。而受独特地理位置与殖民历史影响，在村内沟通竟可能要用上英语、西班牙话等外语。「Kids’ Notes」嘉宾还介绍了客家饮食冷知识，例如现时的甜点糯米糍，就被指是源自传统客家茶粿。谷埔村内保存了不少珍贵的历史建筑，大家如前往参观，宛如穿越时空，重返昔日乡村岁月。嘉宾还推介于村内的芦苇田打卡，是欣赏日落的梦幻好去处。

programme.title: 蓝色管弦乐粤日
programme.desc: 升上高中的青野仍逃避小提琴与人群，却接连得知天才佐伯直入读海幕。重遇大提琴手山田后，他随秋音等人参观管弦乐团，竟被安排与佐伯即场合奏《四季．春》，久违的竞争心与过去亦再度被唤醒。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志之玩转澳门新搞作粤
programme.desc: 长沙湾一个楼盘，有新一期单位交楼，房门设计狭窄，露台外墙有瓷砖已剥落，为何如此？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
有理说得清粤 及 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 两位时事评论员屈颖妍、杨立门，同观众论尽天下事、国家事、香港事；大事小事，开门见山、言无不尽，《有理说得清》！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#76粤
programme.desc: 嘉骢被迫创作黑化圆妃的漫画故事，陈公子更派编辑贴身催稿。嘉骢提出折衷方案，欲加入新角色替代圆妃「做坏事」，陈公子拒不接受更以巨额赔偿逼嘉骢就范。编辑背着陈公子表示支持嘉聪的构思，获嘉骢信任。唐芯到酒吧为嘉骢送银包，编辑趁嘉骢离开向她递上饮料，唐芯不虞有诈……翌日，圆圆及冠一发现嘉骢倒卧街头，神智不清，送院后被验出体内含有多种毒品。唐芯道出当晚发生的事，圆圆得知嘉骢惨况，决定亲自替他解决问题……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#12粤PG
programme.desc: 素希仗着自己怀孕登堂入室，永康事后向菲雅保证其在何家的地位。无双得悉菲雅遭人以影片威胁，内容竟直接指向菲雅有杀害子盈的动机与嫌疑。家俊从另一途径获得影片，胁逼菲雅就范。绮云在宁养院撞见女子Cindy，暗下忧心，因其握有重大秘密。宝儿积极为选秀节目《天选之人》排练，与另一练习生Jennie起冲突，不甘公司偏袒对方。宝儿向德龙透露，想与父亲相认……菲雅在基金会投票上出尔反尔，家俊愤然要公开影片……

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特约：健康一分钟粤
programme.desc: 距离弘大区仅十五分钟车程，就可发掘到瀑布靓景？坐在咖啡厅露台、漫步水畔步道，以不同角度拍出网美级相片。雨天更添寒意，如风藉新鲜龙虾盛宴补暖。珍宝龙虾拼盘啖啖肉，即食拉面亦获龙虾加持，如风大赞似皇帝般享受！踏足汝矣岛公园，如风再次挑战高空，登上热气球竟附送「过山车」体验？汉江美景当前，如风不再是畏高的我！西班牙菜Omakase六百港元有找？如风一尝「白汤匙」大厨融合分子料理的手艺，连碟底都要舐干净！

programme.title: 武则天#33粤普
programme.desc: 媚娘训练李治论政，助他在朝堂一鸣惊人；世民则怀疑李牧假身分。徐慧告发李牧与媚娘旧情，李治亦与李牧正面冲突。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志之玩转澳门新搞作粤
骗中传奇#18粤
programme.desc: 忠正找到四神像，和珅手下亦至，众情急下带走最轻的「顺」神像，和珅手下取走其余三神像。神像地下印有满文，忠正将文字制成拓布，并将「顺」神像收藏好即回京。嘉庆见拓文，娓娓道出当年雍正之手谕，指大清有一祸胎潜伏，真相在「顺」神像内；和珅亦已同步知悉秘密。忠正与玉麟出发找寻「顺」神像秘密，顾井竟遇上宝儿，宝儿套取忠正行踪。玉麟终从「顺」神像得到最后一篇满文，秘密是乾隆竟是汉人，嘉庆要忠正等立即消灭神像。

programme.title: 高朋满座#234粤
programme.desc: 朋与溢将事实告知众人，悦表现出坚强的一面，支撑起大局。晚上朋却发现悦只是在强装镇定，众人开解将失业的溢，溢却表示借此闯一番事业。朋终于接受手术，众人纷纷到医院陪伴，庆更在病床前告诉朋一个秘密。

programme.title: 说英雄谁是英雄#5粤普PG

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.desc: 【何与×虞书欣伪骨科继兄妹禁忌爱恋，从爱妹到暧昧火花四射！！】姜暮9岁前是被家人宠在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之骄子的哥哥。那年父母离婚，两人命运自此走上双轨，爸爸和哥哥移居泰国，成为地下赛车与拳场中的修车工。多年后，19岁的姜暮得知哥哥是被领养的秘密，瞒著所有人独自飞往泰国。在泰国的租屋中两人展开了一段隐秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明与黑暗间重逢，禁忌拉扯中双向救赎。

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫妇的世界

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 双轨
programme.desc: 【何与×虞书欣伪骨科继兄妹禁忌爱恋，从爱妹到暧昧火花四射！！】姜暮9岁前是被家人宠在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之骄子的哥哥。那年父母离婚，两人命运自此走上双轨，爸爸和哥哥移居泰国，成为地下赛车与拳场中的修车工。多年后，19岁的姜暮得知哥哥是被领养的秘密，瞒著所有人独自飞往泰国。在泰国的租屋中两人展开了一段隐秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明与黑暗间重逢，禁忌拉扯中双向救赎。

programme.desc: The bodies of two gallery owners are found. These murders are reminiscent of the death of Suzanne, a painter, 20 years ago. The investigation is led by Marion, Suzanne's daughter, and by Antoine who was in charge of the investigations at the time.

programme.title: The Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: Elise is beautiful, funny, and blind. Theo is a seducer but a loser. They love music. But when they meet in the elevator, it's hate at first sight.

programme.title: A Thousand Times Good Night
programme.desc: Rebecca is one of the world's top war photographers. She must weather a major emotional storm when her husband and young daughters refuse to put up with her dangerous life any longer. They need Rebecca, who, however, loves both her family and her work.

programme.title: SAF
programme.desc: Desperate, Kamil takes a low wage job in Istanbul's urbanization project. In so doing, he displaces a Syrian refugee and partakes in his neighborhood’s destruction, while also needing to pay for the required permits. One day, Kamil suddenly disappears.

programme.title: All The Songs We Never Sang
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Natsumi ventures from Tokyo to a small island to meet her aunt and learn the art of pearl diving (but secretly to find a treasure she was told about as a child).

programme.title: I'm Not In Love
programme.desc: After receiving a marriage ultimatum from a woman he's not sure he truly loves, Rob is up against the clock to realise he should stop looking for the fabled 'Miss Right' and learn to see what's right in front of him.

programme.title: Murders in Porquerolles
programme.desc: The lifeless body of a painter is found on a beach in Porquerolles. Her body at the foot of the cliff evokes the Lycastre, the famous dragon from the legend that gave the bay its name. A rigid prosecutor and a whimsical policewoman team up to investigate.

programme.title: Turkish For Beginners
programme.desc: Could things be worse? While on a vacation she never wanted, Lena’s plane crashes on a remote Andaman island. Now she’s stranded with a sexy Turk, his religious sister and a stuttering Greek

programme.title: Somebody's Xylophone
programme.desc: A routine thank-you note from her young hairstylist sparks a dangerous obsession for housewife Sayoko. As she infiltrates his life, boundaries shatter in Yoichi Higashi’s gripping suspense drama. What happens when loneliness becomes a haunting fixation?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Climate Change, The Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are watching for polar bears, but an iceberg is heading for their ship!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mount Mumandad
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Daddy Dropoff
programme.desc: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Mischevous Dino
programme.desc: Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy and discovers a small unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Toothbrush
programme.desc: Bella tries to brush Lift's teeth, but it is too tickly - can the Playtimers help? This gives Hettie an idea for a dance, the Brush Boogie!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium and big sticks... Lots of sticks!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Sphinx, Egypt
programme.desc: Glitch and the Grimbots are on holiday in Egypt where the Grimbots bury the Great Sphinx in sand, leaving only its head showing.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Everglades National Park, Florida
programme.desc: The Go Jetters save the Florida Everglades when hungry alligators chase Glitch's picnic.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Ace's Brave Jump
programme.desc: Thomas is in Australia where racing car Ace is planning a big jump across lots of buses.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Boo Contest
programme.desc: It's Halloween! Nikhil and Jay both want to win the family Boo Contest, but Jim is impossible to spook. Or is he? They just need to find the one thing that scares him...

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - House
programme.desc: Myrtle's aunt Cressy is coming to stay, and she needs Stanley to make her a bed for her. This escalates into Stanley building her a whole set of rooms outside Myrtles actual house.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Actually Gave Santa a High Five
programme.desc: The talking animals talk about everything they love about Easter, Halloween, and Christmas!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to spot the birds
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are drinking hot chocolate in the park café when a robin lands on their table. JoJo learns that some birds fly away in the winter - that's called migration.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Traffic Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Kiwi

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Getting On Badge
programme.desc: When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Mermaid
programme.desc: Sing along with Maisy Mermaid!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Great Big Painting
programme.desc: One rainy day, Maisy and her friends make a giant painting!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Cabbage
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvelous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Gooseberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's Gooseberry, singing a song about everything you have to do to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tin Can Games
programme.desc: It's the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato's back to stop him from going super fast.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Picnic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a very special picnic together. Lots of Tubby Toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Tractor
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'tractor' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see all sorts of tractors - a blue tractor, a pulling tractor, a stuck in the mud tractor and an on a farm tractor.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Mr Kite Takes Flight
programme.desc: As Messy monster is about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock, it gets blown away!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ice Cream Float
programme.desc: Betty's new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyone's feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mud Volcano, Azerbaijan
programme.desc: Glitch's plan to use methane gas from a mud volcano to power Lars's new machine has explosive results! Can the bickering pair stop a huge fire and save the Grimbots?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Neighbours
programme.desc: Bluey needs her Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's own growing stable of animals.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy, the T Rex and the Volcano
programme.desc: When the ground begins to shake on Dino Island, Jen and Andy suspect the volcano is to blame. Along the way, Andy meets not one, but two T-rex's.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bees
programme.desc: Bella gives Lift a spring clean with her fuzzy, buzzy bee duster! Together they visit Sketch in Boxtropolis. What will she make today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are at a busy train station when JoJo realises Panda is missing! The pair decide to retrace their steps through the station - where could Panda be?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Grandparents Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are tidying up - its Bring your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day. Duggee has his Grandparents badge so he knows what they will like, a nice cup of tea. But on arrival, these Grandparents seem more of a lively bunch than Duggee was expecting! Tag's Gran parachutes in from a plane and Norrie's Gran is a biker and arrives on her motorbike! Once in the clubhouse they launch into Show &amp; Tell. These Grandparents have some GREAT stories to share!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Wedding Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing at the clubhouse when there is a knock at the door. Its delivery Chipmunk with a special delivery for Duggee and the squirrels. Duggee opens the envelope and takes out the card inside: It is with very great pleasure that I invite Duggee and the Squirrels to my Wedding... WOW, King Tiger has met his perfect partner and he is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding!! The squirrels are to be special Guests of Honour, but who is King Tiger marrying!? The event qui

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Flying Party
programme.desc: Maisy flies her plane, and her friends join for a party in the sky.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Mermaid
programme.desc: Sing along with Maisy Mermaid!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Banana
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Banana revealing yet another astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, "I've Got a Secret"

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Cabbage
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvelous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tablet Takeover
programme.desc: The Veggies are delighted with a new tablet they've found. When they're not looking, Evil Pea turns the tablet to evil mode. Soon the tablet takes over the supermarket.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Carrot's Big Top
programme.desc: Carrot is starring in a circus, but problems arise when Evil Pea meddles with her tricks.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Picnic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a very special picnic together. Lots of Tubby Toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. When his old nemesis resurfaces and kidnaps her for an underground trafficking ring, Dong Gu must rely on his heightened hearing and formidable combat skills to hunt down the criminals and rescue his daughter.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...
